title: Evolve the existing application rather than rewrite it
acceptance_summary: New work uses audited seams, adapters, and characterization tests unless an accepted ADR justifies replacement.

title: Preserve supported current maps and workflows
acceptance_summary: Current supported files and core workflows remain available or follow an approved migration/deprecation process.

title: Audit repository before architecture implementation
acceptance_summary: A reproducible repository audit and compatibility matrix exist before major feature work.

title: Strategic graph is the durable source of truth
acceptance_summary: Nodes, edges, identity, metadata, and lifecycle are not owned by renderer coordinates.

title: Use stable identifiers
acceptance_summary: Durable entities retain identity across rename, reorder, views, keyframes, save, and load.

title: Store position in views or projection output
acceptance_summary: A node does not have one universal screen coordinate; current coordinates map to a default Wardley view.

title: Resolve a renderer-neutral display graph
acceptance_summary: Renderer input expresses visible entities, proxy nodes, bundles, normalized coordinates, and provenance without mutating the domain graph.

title: Version advanced persisted documents
acceptance_summary: Advanced documents include an explicit schema version and supported-version diagnostics.

title: Use sequential deterministic migrations
acceptance_summary: Each supported source version migrates through tested sequential transformations.

title: Serialize deterministically
acceptance_summary: Equivalent state produces equivalent canonical output apart from declared variable fields.

title: Preserve unknown compatible data
acceptance_summary: Readers/writers preserve unknown compatible fields where the selected format permits.

title: Report lossy legacy export
acceptance_summary: Flattening or unsupported advanced features are reported before export.

title: Create composite from valid multi-selection
acceptance_summary: A user can create a named composite from arbitrary valid selected nodes.

title: Preserve member graph data
acceptance_summary: Composite creation does not remove member nodes or original edges.

title: Collapse in active view only
acceptance_summary: Collapse hides members/internal edges only in the active view and displays a proxy.

title: Expand losslessly
acceptance_summary: Expand restores exact member identity, topology, and stored view state.

title: Trace boundary edge provenance
acceptance_summary: Every displayed bundle retains all represented original edge IDs.

title: Support undo and redo
acceptance_summary: Create, collapse, expand, dissolve, and membership edits are atomic and reversible.

title: Persist composites
acceptance_summary: Save and reload preserve definitions, membership, policies, and view collapse state.

title: Support duplicate labels
acceptance_summary: Composite behaviour relies on stable IDs rather than labels.

title: Reject membership cycles
acceptance_summary: Cyclic or missing composite references produce actionable diagnostics.

title: Resolve nested collapse deterministically
acceptance_summary: Ancestor/descendant collapse state follows a defined precedence.

title: Apply explicit proxy position policy
acceptance_summary: Composite proxy placement follows declared policy and supports manual override.

title: Aggregate metrics by definition
acceptance_summary: Composite metrics use per-metric aggregation rather than an assumed mean.

title: Diagnose legacy flattening
acceptance_summary: Legacy export reports chosen abstraction/flattening and lost semantics.

title: Keyboard collapse and expand
acceptance_summary: Composite commands can be completed without a pointer.

title: Accessible alternative to lasso
acceptance_summary: A searchable/list-based selection route exists.

title: Meet audited interaction budget
acceptance_summary: Composite resolution remains responsive for the representative medium corpus.

title: Manage keyframes
acceptance_summary: Create, rename, move, and delete keyframes.

title: Resolve exact time deterministically
acceptance_summary: Scrubbing or direct input returns the same semantic state for the same inputs.

title: Interpolate positions by policy
acceptance_summary: Normalized positions use the declared easing and transition rule.

title: Handle categorical and text transitions explicitly
acceptance_summary: Non-numeric values use declared step or cross-fade behaviour.

title: Preserve lifecycle across time
acceptance_summary: Earlier and later states retain correct node and edge existence/status.

title: Create keyframe for intermediate edits
acceptance_summary: Editing between keyframes is explicit and never silently mutates a neighbour.

title: Persist and undo timeline edits
acceptance_summary: Timeline authoring survives reload and participates in undo/redo.

title: Keep entity identity across keyframes
acceptance_summary: A component has one stable ID through temporal states.

title: Keyframe composite collapse state
acceptance_summary: Collapse may vary over time without changing membership.

title: Distinguish projection change from strategic movement
acceptance_summary: Axis/frame changes are visibly identified.

title: Reference temporal state from stories
acceptance_summary: Story chapters can resolve keyframe or exact-time state.

title: Support keyboard and reduced motion
acceptance_summary: Timeline controls and playback have accessible alternatives.

title: Diagnose invalid temporal references
acceptance_summary: Missing or inconsistent keyframe/entity references are not silently ignored.

title: Preserve static map behaviour
acceptance_summary: A document without timelines behaves as it did previously.

title: Represent current Wardley view through the projection contract
acceptance_summary: The adapter reproduces current Wardley semantics without visible regression.

title: Create named projection views
acceptance_summary: Users can define x/y sources, scales, labels, and missing-value behaviour.

title: Produce normalized deterministic coordinates
acceptance_summary: Equivalent inputs and configuration produce equivalent normalized output.

title: Do not mutate graph topology

title: Explain position provenance

title: Handle missing values explicitly
acceptance_summary: Every projection defines and reports its missing-value policy.

title: Support reversible pins and overrides

title: Project composites by declared policy
acceptance_summary: Collapsed composites use explicit aggregation/position rules.

title: Support reduced-motion projection switch
acceptance_summary: Frame changes remain understandable without movement.

title: Diagnose conflicting constraints
acceptance_summary: Conflicts do not create nondeterministic placement.

title: Define typed metrics

title: Retain metric provenance and confidence

title: Import metrics by stable identity

title: Version derived measures

title: Define per-metric aggregation

title: Diagnose metric loss on legacy export

title: Keep navigation state deterministic

title: Support keyboard and reduced motion

title: Provide non-visual map summary

title: Build deterministically

title: Support headless browser assertions

title: Diagnose stale references

title: Exclude speaker notes by default

title: Create versioned component definition

title: Persist mappings and versions

title: Record assumptions

title: Reference scenarios from stories

title: Test native and legacy round trips

title: Protect restricted corpus material

title: Keyboard-equivalent primary workflows
